note: Machine-readable belt contract for conveyor.md. Gates read receipts only from the issue (receipt_home); limits, time boxes and the timetable live in contracts.md § Defaults, never here.

lanes.name: next
lanes.called_at: issues-cli publish (the sweep names candidates and never moves them)

lanes.name: closed
lanes.called_at: monitor end; issues-cli close for an item with no release, from any lane

landed.label: deployed or pushed
landed.pushed_only_if: the project file's Deploy `Targets` names no target other than branches; otherwise deploy: is required, written by the deploy step under the user's own word until a deploy kind exists
landed.undone_by: a Rolled back: line after the push or deploy; landed then needs a newer push or deploy

no_release.note: skills: the belt's own skills ticket, closed after its Approved: skills-install; refused once the issue carries Pushed: or deploy: (only the monitored path closes a landed item)
no_release.label: closed without a release

knowledge.note: Python module agent_skills.knowledge, imported by issues-cli; finds its contract data through layout. Stores named logically in § Map `Knowledge`; local checkouts from workers.json `knowledge_stores`.

find.returns: [{store, file, id, text, source, score, pending}] from answered, decisions and inbox/; source is the row's own link

record.args: kind=decision|lesson|answered, id, date, source, text, scope=global|tenant:<id>|repo:<name>
record.returns: {path} of one new inbox/ file; refuses a duplicate id

knowledge.domain_vocabulary: the store's routing table; conveyor.md lists none

unmapped_brain.reads: wiki only, output says `brain: not configured on this machine`
unmapped_brain.writes: record, collect and log refuse loudly
unmapped_brain.decide: still writes Decision: on the issue; the sweep records the row once the brain is mapped

knowledge.git: the module owns all git in a store, reads included (changes); callers make plain calls and never run git there

action_record.note: Written by run-approved's prepare step; each kind runs one fixed code path; the record carries parameters only, never a command line.

kinds.release: merge the frozen train's PRs and push the target branches; writes Pushed:, never deploy:; a target that is not a branch is refused until the project names deploy targets
kinds.rollback: safeguard rollback to the recorded rollback refs; writes Rolled back:, never Pushed:
kinds.skills-install: install.sh from an export of the recorded tree; writes the settings snippet file, never applies it (settings stay the user's manual step)

fields.train: [{issue, pr, head}] ≤ Release train limit; every item names an issue (the sweep gives an issueless PR one)
fields.tree: git tree sha of the release
fields.digest_input: canonical JSON of every field except digest and used_at
fields.rollback: {target: ref} of each target's current ref at prepare, inside digest_input; the go card's Undo reads it

action_record.no_kind: the belt never runs a gated action without a kind; it stays with the user's own word in the executing session (contracts.md § Consent)

refusal_meaning.not-ready: a train issue is not in ready-to-release with reviewed_yes on its PR's current head
refusal_meaning.dirty-tree: the working tree differs from the recorded tree
refusal_meaning.non-branch-target: release named a target that is not a branch
refusal_meaning.no-issue: a train item names no issue

action_record.after_claim_failure: append Failed: on every train issue; the record stays used

short.shows: the question as one plain sentence, then at most three sentences and one link
sentences: what happens on yes, including when anything goes live
only when it applies: what is not checked, what failed, or what waiting costs
short.words_counted: under the question, the link excluded
short.checks: by exception; at most 'Tests and review passed'

script_fills.goal: goal name and step k of n
script_fills.checked: Checked: plain labels of receipts present · Not yet: labels of receipts missing, never omitted
script_fills.undo: go: from the action record's rollback

detail.go_shows: kind, id and the first 8 characters of the digest, here and in the permission dialog, never in the short form
detail.where: written to the issue by ask; shown behind the link and Tell me more; the record, not the question

card.printed: ask writes detail to the issue and prints short
card.tell_me_more: records asked_more; not a decision; the question returns

receipt_home.read_from: the issue only: body, labels, linked PR, comments
receipt_home.log_copies: a command that writes a log.md line also posts it on the issue; `issues-cli lane <n> <lane> --log <log.md>` copies the stage's receipt lines onto the issue before it checks
receipt_home.train: run-approved posts its Approved:, Pushed:/deploy:, Rollback: or Failed: lines on every train issue and in the release log
receipt_home.build_first: every command builds all its receipt lines before its first write

forms.local_<uuid>: a desktop session; the archive guard applies
forms.<uuid>: a headless worker started through delegate.py; it ends by itself and is never archived by the tool

registry.source: Owner: and Claimed: sessions on belt issues, open or closed
registry.done: the session appears on at least one belt issue and none of them is open and unparked

guards.registry_unfinished: deny (an open, unparked issue names the session)
guards.outside_registry: ask (no belt issue names the session)

monitors.create: allow an id monitor-<repo>-<slug> whose description carries a Deadline; anything else asks
monitors.delete: allow a Scheduler: id on a belt issue once its verdict is recorded; deny before; any other id asks

registry.guard_failure: a guard that cannot load or errors denies
registry.lookup: search belt issues by the session id (and the delete guard by the schedule id), never list every issue; keep a guard under about 2 seconds

layout.root: the directory holding the agent_skills package: a release (has .release-pin.json) or a checkout
layout.release_id: the pin's commit; git HEAD only in a checkout with no pin; neither fails loudly
layout.rule: no other code computes contract paths or runs git for the release id

sweep.fallback_starts: at most 1 per sweep, none without a free test slot
sweep.reconcile: a merged PR moves its issue by receipts; a PR with no issue gets one; an unlabelled issue goes to sort; a teammate's issue gets labels and comments only

feeds.file: feeds.json in project config, layered; shared code names no source

fields.key_fields: stable fields hashed into Source-key, never a row number
fields.store: verbatim (the user's own words) or summary-link

feeds.fetch: GitHub and local files by the script; a connector-only source by a small-model scheduled run that pipes rows to `issues-cli feed <id>`
feeds.intake: issues-cli feed <id> keys each row, finds the issue by Source-key, captures new rows to inbox, comments `Source updated` on a changed one, never closes

heartbeat.silent: two cadences without a heartbeat is a board line; an empty fetch is recorded as empty, a failed fetch as a failure

feeds.investigate: a bug, alert or question at prio:now or prio:next gets a read-only blueprint worker inside the Investigate limit; it ends in an answer, a plan or a card
feeds.build_without_asking: size S with a plan and no open decision is built and reviewed as a draft PR; M and up, or any choice, reach the user as a plan card first

flow.park: issues-cli park <n> --waiting-on <who> --until <date|event>: hand-over comment (branch, head, done, next), closeout of the session, slot freed, label parked
flow.unpark: sweep, on the date or event, at the front of its priority
flow.time_boxes: contracts.md § Defaults `Time boxes`; one box: ask the session for a receipt once; two: park as stalled
flow.sizes: only S and M enter Build; L is split first; an item past its size cap or two boxes ships what is done and files the rest
flow.review_rounds: after 2 NO rounds the next step is a choice card
flow.unanswered_card: parked after its time box and kept first on the user's list; never decides
flow.drain_before_fill: Build pulls nothing while Review is full; Review pulls nothing while a train waits past its time for a GO
flow.board: flow time per size (median, worst), parked count and oldest, items past a time box, items finished per day

roles.why: names the two long-lived sessions the hooks hand resume to

resume.kind: read-only bookkeeping; its only write is the Checkpoint: line
resume.shows: the sweep's board plus what changed since the last checkpoint: questions waiting with exact option text, lane counts, sessions the belt owns and their state, parked items and why, decisions since the checkpoint, commands that started and wrote no receipt

hooks.SessionStart: adds the resume output for a session named in `roles`; other sessions keep the git snapshot
hooks.PreCompact: prints the same picture as instructions for the summary: keep these exactly

resume.after_compaction: a coordinator states no fact about a session, PR, approval or owner from its summary alone; it reads resume first
